chat.title: Chat with Mate
chat.empty: Write your question, for example: "How do I make the text bigger?" I will answer here and show you on the screen.
chat.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. Up to 1000 characters. History stays on this computer.
chat.send_failed: Your message could not be sent. Please try again.
chat.save_failed: Chat could not be cleared on this computer. Please try again.
chat.load_failed: Chat could not be opened. Please close this window and try again.
robot.first_launch: Hello! I'm {name}. Press and hold {key}, then ask me. Or click me once, speak, and click me again.
robot.no_microphone: I can't hear you: no microphone is working. Right-click me and choose Chat to type instead.
robot.open_browser_first: Open your web browser first, then ask me again.
robot.looking: One moment. I'm looking only at this window.
robot.found_it: Here it is. Look where I'm pointing.
robot.click_app_first: Click in the app first, then press the keys.
robot.wrong_place: Almost. Click right where I'm pointing.
robot.cant_find: I can't see that here. Let's open the right window first.
robot.private_window: I cannot safely inspect this window.
robot.look_consent: This window may contain private content I cannot identify. Press and release F8, then press F8 again to share this window once, or Esc to cancel.
robot.password_covered: I covered your password before looking.
robot.login_page: A password may be visible here. Hide it, then I'll look.
robot.do_it_for_me: Should I press this button for you? Say yes or no.
robot.wont_press: I don't press Pay or Delete. I'll show you where it is.
robot.press_cancelled: Of course. I won't press it. Take your time.
robot.press_failed: I couldn't press it safely. Please press it yourself.
robot.network_error: I can't connect right now. Let's try again in a minute.
robot.too_many_turns: This is taking too long. Let's try another way.
robot.calm_mode: Calm mode is on. I'll keep sounds gentle.
robot.fun_mode: Fun mode is on. Let's have some fun!
robot.sleep: I'll wait in the corner. Call me anytime.
robot.wake: I'm back. How can I help?
robot.protected_window: This window is protected. I can't see inside it.
robot.security_prompt: Please answer the Windows security window first.
robot.other_monitor: It's on your other screen; look there.
robot.window_closed: The window I was watching closed; ask me again.
robot.cant_look: I couldn't see this window clearly; please try again.
tray.try_bigger: How do I make the text bigger?
robot.checking_safety: Let me check this carefully. I'm looking only at this window.
robot.thinking_harder: Let me think about this a bit harder.
auth.browser_done: MetaMate is finishing your sign-in. Close this tab.
auth.browser_failed: Signing in did not work. Close this tab and try again from MetaMate.
settings.ptt_hold_hint: Hold the key down while you speak, then let go.
settings.ptt_toggle_hint: Press once to start, again when you finish. Easier if holding a key is hard.
settings.saved_note: Changes are saved right away. Close this window when you are done.
settings.save_failed: This choice is in effect, but could not be saved. It may be lost when you restart.
settings.spotlight: Dim the rest of the screen while I point
settings.start_with_windows: Start MetaMate when the computer turns on
settings.model_quick_hint: Answers fast. Best for everyday help. Uses Muse Spark 1.3.
settings.model_thorough_hint: Thinks longer about tricky tasks. Slower. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0.
onboarding.example_2: How do I make the text bigger?
onboarding.example_4: How do I open a new tab?
onboarding.example_6: How do I print this page?
card.placeholder_title: How to make the text bigger
card.credits_glimmer: Words by Muse Glimmer (Meta open weights) · Picture by Muse Image
card.image_alt: A picture of {name} celebrating this lesson with you
auth.title: Account
auth.why: So {name} can answer you: each account gets its own daily allowance
auth.busy: Sign-in is already open in your browser.
signin.title: Sign in, or try it first
signin.intro: Sign in once with Google or GitHub, and {name} can start helping you.
signin.browser: Your web browser will open. Choose your account there, then come back to this window.
signin.done: You are signed in. This window closes now.
robot.sign_in_first: Please sign in first. I opened the sign-in window.
robot.sign_in_again: My sign-in has expired. Please sign in again: I opened the sign-in window.
signin.guest_left: Without signing in: {left} of {limit} messages left this hour.
signin.guest_none: The free messages for this hour are used. Sign in to keep going.
robot.guest_limit: The free messages for this hour are used. Please sign in.
home.intro: Ask me out loud, and I light up the button you need. Say "do it for me", and I press it after your yes.
robot.click_stop: Click me again when you finish.
home.talk_click: Or click me once, speak, and click me again.
home.talk_hold: Press and hold {key} while you speak.
home.talk_release: Let go when you have finished.
home.where_rightCtrl: Ctrl is at the bottom right, by the arrow keys.
home.where_rightAlt: Alt is just right of the space bar.
home.where_capsLock: Caps Lock is on the left edge of the keyboard.
home.where_insert: Insert is at the top right (Ins on laptops).
home.where_f9: F9 is in the top row of the keyboard.
home.where_f10: F10 is in the top row of the keyboard.
home.try_intro: First open the program you need help with, like your web browser. {name} looks at that program, not at this window.
home.try_safe_hint: {name} checks the window and tells you.
home.try_asked: {name} is looking at your program now. Watch for the light.
home.try_failed: That didn't work just now. Please try again in a moment.
home.never_press: He never presses Pay, Delete or password buttons. He only shows you where they are.
home.never_look: He never looks on his own: only at the window you are using, and only when you ask.
home.never_passwords: He never sees your passwords: they are painted over before he looks.
home.cards_text: After a lesson, {name} makes a picture card of the steps for you to keep or print.
home.show_at_start: Show this window when MetaMate starts
home.closed_hint: I'm still here. Right-click me to hide me or quit.
mate.hiding: I'll be back at {time}. Hold {key} to call me sooner.
mate.explain_offer: "{control}": click me and I'll tell you what it does.
mate.explain_question: In two short sentences, what is "{control}" ({type}) for in the {app} app?
